description: Update fields on ONE workflow trigger (PATCH — only fields you supply are changed). Use get_workflow_trigger first to see its current shape.

filter_custom_field_query.description: Custom-field filter as a JSON expression passed as a string. A condition is [field, operator, value], where field is the custom field's name or ID. Combine conditions with ["AND", [cond, …]] or ["OR", [cond, …]], and negate with ["NOT", cond]. Valid operators depend on the field's data type (e.g. exact, in, isnull, exists, icontains, gt, gte, lt, lte, range); pick an invalid one and Paperless names the valid ones. Examples: '["Amount", "gte", 100]', '["AND", [["Due", "lt", "2026-10-01"], ["Paid", "exact", false]]]'. Checked for types 2–4 (added, updated, scheduled) only — not at consumption start, when the document has no content or metadata yet.

filter_filename.description: Filename pattern (the whole name must match, case-insensitive), * wildcards allowed. Works for every trigger type: at consumption start it checks the incoming file's name, for types 2–4 the document's original file name.

filter_has_all_tags.description: Document has ALL of these tags. Checked for types 2–4 (added, updated, scheduled) only — not at consumption start, when the document has no content or metadata yet.

filter_has_any_correspondents.description: Correspondent is one of these. Checked for types 2–4 (added, updated, scheduled) only — not at consumption start, when the document has no content or metadata yet.

filter_has_any_document_types.description: Document type is one of these. Checked for types 2–4 (added, updated, scheduled) only — not at consumption start, when the document has no content or metadata yet.

filter_has_any_storage_paths.description: Storage path is one of these. Checked for types 2–4 (added, updated, scheduled) only — not at consumption start, when the document has no content or metadata yet.

filter_has_not_correspondents.description: Correspondent is none of these. Checked for types 2–4 (added, updated, scheduled) only — not at consumption start, when the document has no content or metadata yet.

filter_has_not_document_types.description: Document type is none of these. Checked for types 2–4 (added, updated, scheduled) only — not at consumption start, when the document has no content or metadata yet.

filter_has_not_storage_paths.description: Storage path is none of these. Checked for types 2–4 (added, updated, scheduled) only — not at consumption start, when the document has no content or metadata yet.

filter_has_not_tags.description: Document has NONE of these tags. Checked for types 2–4 (added, updated, scheduled) only — not at consumption start, when the document has no content or metadata yet.

filter_has_tags.description: Document has ANY of these tags. Checked for types 2–4 (added, updated, scheduled) only — not at consumption start, when the document has no content or metadata yet.

filter_mailrule.description: Consumption-started (type 1) triggers only: only documents fetched by this mail rule ID

filter_path.description: Consumption-started (type 1) triggers only: consume-folder path pattern, * wildcards allowed

matching_algorithm.description: Content match for `match`: 0=none, 1=any word, 2=all words, 3=exact, 4=regular expression, 5=fuzzy word. Checked for types 2–4 (added, updated, scheduled) only — not at consumption start, when the document has no content or metadata yet.

schedule_date_custom_field.description: Type 4 with schedule_date_field=custom_field: the date custom field ID

schedule_date_field.description: Type 4: date the schedule is based on

schedule_offset_days.description: Type 4: days to offset from schedule_date_field

sources.description: Consumption-started (type 1) triggers only: consumption sources 1=consume folder, 2=API upload, 3=mail fetch, 4=web UI (default [1,2,3])
